name: Slave/Master ~Kanojo to Kanojo o Shibatta Kusari~
original_name: Slave/Master～彼女とカノジョを縛った鎖～
source:
Shuusuke was sexually unsatisfied and tired of the game.
That's when his younger twin Yuusuke asked for advice:
"How do you get all the way to making it with a girl?"
Shuusuke's heart lifted at his brother's enthusiasm.
But not to help. He saw a chance to revive his own
libido by stealing away the subject of his brother's love. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066963.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
修介在性方面得不到滿足，對遊戲也感到厭倦。就在這時，他的雙胞胎弟弟佑介向他請教：「要怎樣才能和女孩發展到那一步？」修介對弟弟的熱情為之心動。但並不是為了幫忙。他看到了一個機會——透過奪走弟弟的心上人來重燃自己的性慾。

［來自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066963.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
